subject.title: Bound diagnostic config file read with size cap

question: Is the 8 MiB cap acceptable for diagnostic exports when an existing larger config will omit `config/shape.json` content but the rest of the bundle remains available?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility tradeoff in a user-controlled configuration path; the proposed code handles it gracefully, but the acceptable maximum is product and support-policy judgment rather than a mechanical correctness choice.

options.title: Accept the 8 MiB diagnostic cap
options.body: Keep the bounded read and graceful failure because preventing diagnostic-export memory exhaustion outweighs losing config-shape detail for unusually large configs.

options.title: Choose a different documented cap
options.body: Set a different bounded limit if support experience shows legitimate exported configs can exceed 8 MiB while still requiring bounded allocation.

recommendation.title: Accept the 8 MiB diagnostic cap
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded read and graceful failure because preventing diagnostic-export memory exhaustion outweighs losing config-shape detail for unusually large configs.
